# SimplePixelArt

> SimplePixelArt.com is a free, browser-based pixel art maker and community gallery. People draw pixel art on a grid, turn photos into pixel art, animate sprites and build game tilemaps, with no download and no sign-up needed to start. Every piece in the gallery opens in the editor, so it can be studied or remixed with credit to the original artist.

The site is available in English (default), Japanese (/ja), Chinese (/zh), Korean (/ko), Spanish (/es), Portuguese (/pt) and Russian (/ru). Gallery art is made by community members; character fan art is not official artwork.

## Tools

- [Pixel art maker](https://simplepixelart.com/editor): the main editor. Brush, fill, layers, mirror mode, palettes, animation frames; export PNG, GIF or sprite sheet. Canvases up to 128×128.
- [Image to pixel art converter](https://simplepixelart.com/converter): turn a photo or image into pixel art with a chosen grid size and 4–64 color palette.
- [AI pixel art generator](https://simplepixelart.com/generator): describe a sprite and get editable pixel art from 16×16 to 128×128.
- [Sprite maker](https://simplepixelart.com/sprite-maker): draw and animate game sprites, export a sprite sheet for Unity, Godot or Phaser.
- [Pixel art animation maker](https://simplepixelart.com/pixel-art-animation-maker): frame-by-frame animation with onion skin, exported as GIF or sprite sheet.
- [Tilemap editor](https://simplepixelart.com/tilemaps/editor): paint game maps on a square or isometric grid with layers of tiles and sprites.
- [Tileset slicer](https://simplepixelart.com/tilesets/slicer): cut a sprite sheet or tileset into separate sprites and download them as a ZIP.
- [Color palettes](https://simplepixelart.com/palettes): ready-made pixel art palettes (retro, pastel, Game Boy and more), plus palettes from an image or a color.
- [Pixel art color by number](https://simplepixelart.com/color-by-number): relaxing coloring of pixel pictures in the browser.

## Learn and browse

- [Easy pixel art](https://simplepixelart.com/easy-pixel-art): beginner guide with small grids, four steps and easy pieces to copy.
- [How to make pixel art](https://simplepixelart.com/learn/how-to-make-pixel-art): step-by-step tutorial.
- [Pixel art ideas](https://simplepixelart.com/ideas): drawing ideas by theme (animals, food, characters, holidays).
- [Pixel art sizes](https://simplepixelart.com/arts/sizes): every canvas size with its gallery, e.g. [16×16](https://simplepixelart.com/arts/size-16x16), [32×32](https://simplepixelart.com/arts/size-32x32).
- [Gallery](https://simplepixelart.com/arts): community pixel art, filterable by size, tag, animation and license.
- [Tilesets](https://simplepixelart.com/tilesets): community tilesets for the tilemap editor.
